violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. PIC washed, rinsed and sanitized slicer at time of inspection. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Observed a brownish water dripping from ceiling in the back storage area at time of inspection. Per interview with staff member a pipe burst on Friday. The establishment has multiple air-drying machines throughout the facility at time of inspection. 5-403.12 Other Liquid Wastes and Rainwater. Condensate drainage and other nonSEWAGE liquids and rainwater shall be drained from point of discharge to disposal according to LAW. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The ceiling tiles in the (back) area is in poor repair (missing) and one stained. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back storage) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The floors throughout the facility and in walk-in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. Spill observed in walk-in cooler underneath the shelf. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Inadequate lighting was observed in the walk-in cooler. 6-303.11 Intensity. The light intensity shall be: -At least 108 lux (10-foot candles) at 75 cm (30 inches) above the floor, in walk-in refrigeration units and dry FOOD storage areas and in other areas and rooms during periods of cleaning; -At least 540 lux (50 foot candles) at a surface where a FOOD EMPLOYEE is working with FOOD or working with UTENSILS or EQUIPMENT such as knives, slicers, grinders, or saws where EMPLOYEE safety is a factor. -Establishment shall replace bulbs with a brighter one. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
